headlines.title: Vucic resigns as Serbia's president, setting up election that could see him become PM
Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
Populist Serbian president resigning to run for prime minister in snap election
Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic has resigned, setting up an election that could see him become prime minister. [1][5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR SERBIA
Vucic's resignation and potential shift to prime minister occurs while Serbia is linked to 51 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Serbia's net energy import dependency of 41% could pose a risk to economic stability during the political transition. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on whether Aleksandar Vučić will be the next Prime Minister of Serbia is priced Yes at 68% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Jun 30, 2028. [E5]
A Kalshi market on whether Aleksandar Vučić will be Prime Minister of Serbia after the next election is priced Yes at 32% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Dec 31, 2028. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the snap election following Vucic's resignation remains unresolved. [1][2]
